items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I heard he played with Jack Lane, Papa Lane, they called him sometimes. [INTERVIEWEE] He played with white bands.

ctx.x: No, just near Contoy. Not Contoy, Clio. Yes, I remember. Yeah, because the car used to go back there. And that's when you took lessons from Dave Perkins uptown, didn't you? Dave Perkins, yeah. Yeah. Yeah, I lived in the room then. Well, I think of Dave Perkins again. Was he playing in any band in those days or just teaching? He used to play with white bands. That's right.
I heard he played with Jack Lane, Papa Lane, they called him sometimes. Yeah, yeah.
He played with white bands. Even in those days, he was playing with white bands. Yeah.
